name: Khrueang Market
description: The central marketplace of the largest skycity, a hub of commerce and gossip. The ambient noise of thousands of conversations creates a constant background hum that makes precise tonal work difficult. Good for social encounters, trade negotiations, and overhearing rumors.

name: The Anchor Spire
description: A massive resonance anchor extending from a floating island into the lattice below. The harmonic vibration creates a powerful, steady tone that calms emotions but makes stealth impossible. Good for dramatic confrontations and moments of revelation.

name: Phrao Monastery
description: The monastery-city where Listeners study the lattice's song. The carefully maintained acoustic environment allows for precise tonal experiments. Good for gaining knowledge, spiritual encounters, and technical training.

name: The Lattice Surface
description: The crystalline ground itself, seen from a safe observation platform. The shifting patterns of light and sound are beautiful but dangerous. Good for moments of awe, scavenging missions, and reminders of the world's perilous nature.

name: Resonance Ship Deck
description: The deck of a ship navigating between skycities. The wind, the ship's engine tones, and the ever-changing lattice below create a dynamic environment. Good for travel sequences, ship-to-ship encounters, and moments of isolation.

name: Tha Khwae Scrapyard
description: The industrial edge of the scavenger city, where old ships are broken down. The clanging metal and running engines create a harsh acoustic environment. Good for mechanical problem-solving, underworld contacts, and salvage missions.

name: The Hollow
description: A rare cave system inside a floating island with ancient pre-Silencing ruins. The natural acoustics create unusual echo patterns. Good for discovery, archaeological mystery, and encounters with the unknown.

name: Mae Rim's Hanging Gardens
description: Agricultural terraces on the edge of a farming skycity. The quiet, rhythmic sounds of wind through crops and flowing water create a peaceful atmosphere. Good for rest, reflection, pastoral encounters, and agricultural subplots.

name: The Silent Zone
description: A dead region where the lattice does not respond to sound. The unnatural quiet is deeply unsettling to the characters. Good for horror, mystery, survival challenges, and existential unease.

name: The Tonal Archives
description: The great library where all known safe routes and tonal patterns are recorded. The hushed reverence and precise acoustic design create a focused environment. Good for research, planning, and uncovering lost knowledge.

name: Sri Thep Ruins
description: The buried remnants of the greatest pre-Silencing city, now half-sunk into the lattice. Ancient resonance technology still flickers in its halls. Good for uncovering lost history, powerful artifacts, and the truth about what caused the Silencing.

name: The Wharf of Echoes
description: A clandestine docking point for smugglers and pirates hidden inside a resonant cavern. The overlapping echoes make it nearly impossible to eavesdrop. Good for illicit deals, finding forbidden goods, and meeting unsavory contacts.

name: Crystal Core Depths
description: The deepest accessible point of the lattice, where the crystal formations grow largest and most unstable. The concentrated resonance can amplify a Singer's power tenfold or shatter their mind. Good for high-stakes power moments and terrible sacrifices.

name: The Floating Necropolis
description: A skycity abandoned after a plague, now inhabited only by the dead and those who tend them. The mourning songs of the caretakers create a haunting ambient tone throughout. Good for ghost stories, memorials, and confronting mortality.

name: The Resonance Forge
description: A hidden workshop where illegal resonance devices are crafted. The constant hammering and tonal calibration create a deafening environment. Good for gear acquisition, meeting rebels, and learning forbidden technology.

name: Skybridge Terminals
description: The vast network of cable bridges connecting the skycities at their closest points. Wind howls through the suspension cables creating an ever-present whistling drone. Good for perilous crossings, ambushes, and vertigo-inducing vistas.

name: The Order Citadel
description: The imposing headquarters of the Tonal Orders, a fortress of smooth black stone that absorbs all unauthorized sound. Good for political intrigue, trials, imprisonment sequences, and confrontations with authority.

name: The Shimmering Sea
description: A vast region where the lattice surface has liquefied into a reflective ocean of liquid crystal. Ships sail on its surface harvesting rare resonance pearls. Good for nautical adventures, beauty, and encounters with sea creatures adapted to lattice.

name: Wind Shear Cliffs
description: The broken edge of a skycity that sheared off during a lattice storm. Jagged platforms and unstable debris float in a chaotic pattern. Good for survival scenarios, scavenging, and environmental hazards.

name: The Chromatic Grotto
description: A natural cave within a floating island where lattice crystal formations refract light into impossible colors. The tonal resonance here produces polyphonic effects. Good for Duangjai's people, mysterious rituals, and transcendent experiences.

name: Moonwell Platform
description: A circular maintenance platform surrounds a vertical crystal well that repeats every sound after a long, luminous pause. The delayed echoes expose hidden conversations and make hurried tonal work dangerous, ideal for patient investigations and tense testimony.

name: Iron Kite Docks
description: Cargo kites moor to iron spars above a roaring updraft, their cables singing different notes under load. Crews can repair engines and bargain for passage here, but one wrong vibration can turn a routine launch into a rescue.

name: Singing Rice Terraces
description: Floating rice beds ripple in ordered waves, producing a soft chord whenever the wind crosses the stalks. Farmers use the living rhythm to detect lattice storms, making the terraces a peaceful refuge and an early-warning station.

name: Undertone Bazaar
description: A market built beneath a suspended island amplifies low voices while swallowing high ones. Smugglers, clerks, and informants meet under its acoustic blind spot, where a carefully chosen phrase can reveal more than a shouted accusation.

name: Lattice Fisheries
description: Scavenger platforms drift over a shallow field of liquid crystal where resonance fish follow familiar melodies. Harvesters must keep a steady call while moving between transparent shelves, creating room for survival work, ethical arguments, and sudden storms.

name: Bellflower Observatory
description: A ring of bell-shaped instruments hangs from an observation tower and rings when the lattice geometry shifts. Cartographers come for precise measurements, while the Orders come to control what the bells are allowed to say.

name: Broken Tether Field
description: Fragments of failed resonance anchors float in a slow spiral below a deserted island. Each shard carries a different remembered tone, turning navigation into a hazardous act of listening and offering clues about abandoned skycities.

name: Echo Cistern
description: An old water reservoir beneath a farming district returns speech from the wrong direction. Its clean acoustics are useful for rehearsing tonal phrases, but the borrowed voices have begun answering questions no one asked.

name: Cloudstep Village
description: A small settlement hangs from a chain of buoyant stone steps, and every footfall makes the homes sway in sympathy. Residents rely on communal songs to keep the steps aligned, making any dispute immediately physical.

name: Resonant Greenhouse
description: A sealed greenhouse grows crystal-veined plants under a carefully tuned canopy. Its leaves filter harmful frequencies from the air, while a locked inner room preserves a living record of the Silencing.
